title: IT Security Associate - Governance, Compliance and Risk
description:
**Position:**  
IT Security Associate - Governance, Compliance and Risk
  
  
**Job Description:**  
About the Role
  
  
Arrow Electronics is looking for a Governance, Risk and Compliance apprentice to join our IT Risk and Governance team in India. This role is built specifically for a student who has completed a university degree and who wants to learn how information security governance actually works inside a global technology distributor, rather than only in a textbook. You will sit with the team that owns Arrows security certifications, risk framework and compliance programs, and you will contribute to live work from your first month.
  
We do not expect you to arrive knowing our frameworks. We expect curiosity, care with detail, and the willingness to ask questions in a room full of experienced practitioners. Everything else is taught, and your schedule is designed around your coursework and examinations.
  
  
About the Team
  
  
IT Risk and Governance is part of Arrows Enterprise Security Services organization. The team maintains the Information Security Risk Management Framework, owns the security policy and standards library, runs third-party and vendor risk assessments, and delivers the certification programs that Arrows customers and contracts depend on. Our current portfolio includes the global ISO 27001 certification program spanning the Americas, EMEA and APAC, CMMC Level 2 readiness for our aerospace and defense business, TISAX assessments for automotive customers, and the consolidation of our GRC tooling onto a single platform.
  
The team is deliberately small and global. Members include information security architects, IT compliance analysts, a data security analyst and project managers, working across US, EMEA and APAC time zones. The apprentice reports to the Director, IT Risk and Governance and works day to day alongside a compliance analyst and a security architect.
  
  
What You Will Work On
  
  
The work is real and it changes with the program calendar. Over the course of the apprenticeship you can expect to contribute to several of the following.
  
  

* Evidence collection and tracking for the global ISO 27001 certification program, including chasing outstanding artefacts from control owners and keeping the evidence register current.
* Support for CMMC Level 2 readiness activities, such as maintaining control status trackers and helping assemble documentation packages ahead of assessment milestones.
* Third-party and vendor risk assessments: reviewing questionnaire responses against our Vendor Risk Assessment Standard and flagging gaps for an analyst to validate.
* Migration and data quality work as we consolidate our GRC tooling onto a unified platform, including mapping controls between frameworks and cleaning up legacy records.
* Maintenance of the security policy and standards governance library, including formatting, version control and tracking annual review dates.
* Preparation of recurring reporting, including program status summaries and metrics that go to security leadership.

Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Keep assigned trackers, registers and evidence repositories accurate and current, and raise items that are slipping before they become escalations.
* Draft clear, concise summaries of findings and status for review by an analyst, architect or the director.
* Follow up with control owners and other stakeholders across Arrow to request evidence, clarify responses and confirm closure of open items.
* Compare documentation and questionnaire responses against published Arrow standards and applicable control frameworks, and record where they do not line up.
* Handle confidential and restricted information with the discretion the classification requires, and complete all assigned security training on time.
* Attend program stand-ups and take accurate notes, actions and owners.
* Ask when something is unclear rather than guessing, and tell your mentor early when coursework will affect your availability.

What You Will Learn
  
  
This apprenticeship is structured as a learning path, not an administrative placement. By the end of twelve months a successful apprentice should be able to do the following.
  
  

* Explain how an ISO 27001 certification cycle runs end to end, from scoping and evidence to external audit and corrective action.
* Read a control framework such as ISO 27001 Annex A or NIST SP 800-171 and trace a requirement to the evidence that satisfies it.
* Run the first pass of a vendor risk assessment against a published standard.
* Work confidently inside a GRC platform, including control mapping, task assignment and reporting.
* Write for a security leadership audience: short, factual, and clear about what changed and what needs a decision.

Who We Are Looking For
  
  
Required
  
  

* Currently enrolled in a bachelors or masters program at a recognized university in India, with at least one academic year remaining at the start of the apprenticeship.
* Studying a relevant field such as information technology, computer science, cyber security, information systems, engineering, commerce, law or business administration. We hire for aptitude, not for a single degree.
* Strong written and spoken English, since most of the team and its stakeholders are outside India.
* Comfortable with Microsoft Excel, Word, PowerPoint and Teams, and willing to learn new tools quickly.
* Genuinely careful with detail. Much of this work is the difference between an assessment that passes and one that does not.
* Available for the agreed weekly hours and able to overlap with colleagues in EMEA and the United States for part of the week.

Preferred
  
  

* Coursework, certification study or project work touching information security, audit, risk management or data privacy.
* Familiarity with any control framework or standard, including ISO 27001, NIST, SOC 2, PCI DSS or GDPR, at an introductory level.
* Exposure to a GRC, ticketing or project tracking platform, or to basic data handling in Excel or Power BI.
* Student leadership, campus club, hackathon or volunteer experience that shows follow-through.
* An interest in continuing in security governance after graduation. Strong apprentices are our first consideration for entry-level openings on the team.

What’s in for you
  
  

* On the job skill-based training, projects, assignments, opportunity to learn new skills.
* Annual Fixed Stipend (INR 30,000 per month)
* Insurance (Self):
* Medical : Coverage of INR 500,000/-
* Accidental Life as per policy
* Time off:
* 20 days of Annual leave
* 12 days of Casual/Sick leave
* 10 days of Holidays (Festival National)

About Arrow
  
**Arrow Electronics, Inc. (NYSE:** ARW), an award-winning Fortune 148 and one of Fortune Magazine’s Most Admired Companies. Arrow guides innovation forward for over 220,000 leading technology manufacturers and service providers. With 2025 sales of USD$30.9 billion, Arrow develops technology solutions that improve business and daily life. Our broad portfolio that spans the entire technology landscape helps customers create, make and manage forward-thinking products that make the benefits of technology accessible to as many people as possible. Learn more at www.arrow.com.
  
  
Our strategic direction of guiding innovation forward is expressed as Five Years Out, a way of thinking about the tangible future to bridge the gap between whats possible and the practical technologies to make it happen. Learn more at https://www.fiveyearsout.com/.

title: Compliance Analyst
description:

Ø Application change management and software development life cycle controls


Ø Security hardening and vulnerability patching of operating systems and databases


Ø IT user access permissions and periodic user access reviews


Ø General user access — security audit logs, monitoring evidence and review


Ø Privileged user access (ie Firefighter usage) and privileged activity review


Ø Governance and review of operating systems and databases privileged access


Ø Password policies and baseline identity controls (SSO/MFA principles)


Ø Software compliance and security — web vulnerability management


Ø SWIFT Customer Security Programme (CSP) compliance


• Run the day\-to\-day operation of the global security awareness programme: plan and launch phishing simulations and training campaigns, follow up completion, and report on results


Ø Track training completion and phishing click/report rates, and propose improvements to campaign content, targeting and follow\-up


• Collaborate with the SAP Basis Security \& Authorization team to review and report SoD violations


• Coordinate the global vulnerability management process: consolidate scan results, prioritise on risk, track remediation with infrastructure, application and OT owners,and escalate overdue or high\-risk items


• Prepare the monthly, quarterly and annual compliance, vulnerability and awareness reports for the Global Security \& Compliance Manager and for Carmeuse IT leadership


• Support internal and external audits (including GITC): prepare evidence packs, coordinate control owners, support walkthroughs, and track findings through to closure
• Maintain the security governance documentation (policies, standards, procedures, control narratives and the exception register) and participate in ITSC and cyber security team meetings
• Ensure that Carmeuse's regulatory and audit compliance controls are secure and auditable, in
• line with the established security, audit and regulatory requirements (GDPR, NIS2, SAP security audits, SWIFT and GITC)
• Operate the global security awareness and vulnerability management follow\-up processes, driving measurable improvement in employee behaviour and remediation performance
• Maintain the compliance documentation, metrics and reporting used by the Global Security \& Compliance Manager and by IT leadership
**Key performance indicators :**Compliance and audit findings closed on time; vulnerability remediation
performance against the agreed SLAs (critical / high); security awareness results (training completion rate, phishing simulation click and report rates); timeliness and quality of the compliance evidence, metrics and reporting.
